免费和 AI 有什么区别？: How do free and AI translation differ?
免费模式用翻译服务翻译正文，再按规则保留英文表达，可能不够自然。AI 模式更灵活: Free mode uses a translation service and rules to keep English expressions, so results may sound less natural. AI mode is more flexible: open Settings, choose AI translation and enter your own DeepSeek key. Your provider charges for usage.
译文会在当前浏览器缓存，重复翻译相同内容时直接使用。旧缓存自动清理，也可在设置中: Translations are cached in this browser and reused for identical content. Old entries are removed automatically; you can also clear the cache in Settings. There is no article library or website sync. Text is sent to the selected translation service only when you click Translate.

翻译时，正文会发给谁？: Who receives the text for translation?
你主动点击翻译后，插件读取当前网页正文或选中的段落。免费模式将待翻译文字发送到: After you click Translate, the extension reads the current page or selected paragraphs. Free mode sends text to Google (translate.googleapis.com). AI mode sends it to the model provider selected in Settings, with DeepSeek as the default address. The extension does not automatically translate every page you visit or collect your full browsing history.
免费服务使用带有待译文字的 HTTPS 请求参数；服务商可能记录这些请求。 AI: The free service uses HTTPS query parameters containing the text; the provider may log these requests. AI mode also queries the provider's model list and authenticates using your API key. Providers receive connection information such as your IP address and set their own retention, use and deletion rules. Check their privacy policies and do not send confidential content you are not authorized to share with them.
网页标题、来源网址、原文与译文作为翻译缓存在当前浏览器中保存，旧缓存自动淘汰。设: Page titles, source URLs, originals and translations are cached in this browser, with older cache entries removed automatically. Settings and API keys are also stored locally. Only trusted extension pages and its background process can access the key, not websites or content scripts. Local storage is not an encrypted password vault. This data is not synced through the WordWeave website or sent to its operator. The extension includes no advertising or behavioral analytics service.
当前标签页和脚本权限用于在你点击后读取正文、展示译文；存储权限用于保存设置与翻译: Active-tab and scripting permissions read text and display translations after your click. Storage keeps settings and translation cache. Google host permissions support free translation. Optional host permissions are requested only for the provider you configure for AI. Custom providers require HTTPS; local development addresses may use HTTP.
在插件设置中点击「删除已保存的 Key」会清除保存的凭据并切回免费翻译，翻译缓存: Delete saved key in extension Settings removes the credential and switches to free translation, keeping the cache. Requests already in progress may still finish. Revoke the key in your provider console to invalidate it.
在设置页点击「清除翻译缓存」可以删除当前翻译缓存。旧版本已保存的文章和收藏暂时保: Clear translation cache in Settings removes the current cache. Articles and favorites from older versions remain stored but no article library is shown; clearing the new cache does not delete those older records. Uninstalling removes all local extension data, including the API key. Revoke the key with your provider to invalidate it. Uninstalling does not recall requests already sent. Extension and website records are separate.
